description: Lists the Mercury panels configured on the NetBox system, optionally filtered (wraps NBAPI GetMercuryPanels). Returns an empty collection (or a FAIL/"NOT FOUND") on a system with no Mercury hardware.

ALLPARTITIONS.description: Optional. "TRUE" to list Mercury panels across all partitions.

MERCURYKEY.description: Optional. Restrict the listing to this Mercury panel key.

NAME.description: Optional. Restrict the listing to Mercury panels with this name.

PARTITIONKEY.description: Optional. Restrict the listing to this partition key.

name: get_mercury_panels
